notes:
1.3.2: fixed editor header/footer, lab check hidden until ticked, panels scroll inside

- Task, work-package and note editors: the title stays at the top, Files & outputs and
  Save / Delete / Cancel stay at the bottom; only the fields scroll
- Task editor: lab condition fields are hidden until 'Use a lab condition check' is ticked;
  notes moved above it
- PC and tablet: the window no longer scrolls as a whole. The header stays put and each panel
  scrolls on its own (Today's two columns, Week grid and side panel, master plan, timeline,
  board columns); other views scroll under the fixed header. Scroll positions are kept when
  the screen refreshes. Phones keep normal scrolling.
